title: Design System: Petcare — Stoneware & Collar Tag

display.purpose: Consultation welcome headline (28px sm+) and Booking flow header (26px sm+) in Glazed Slate.

headline.purpose: Lookup search hero, modal confirmation title, and error recovery heading.

title.purpose: Card header titles, step headings (01–03), and live ledger title.

body.purpose: Primary Vietnamese UI copy, form values, service descriptions, and Markdown replies (14px–15px, max 65ch–68ch).

label.purpose: Form field labels, collar-tag species buttons, corridor badges, and status chips.

mono.purpose: JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums for VND prices, kg tiers, slot times, dates, timings, and BK- booking codes.

shadows.name: ledger-float
shadows.purpose: Subtle warm shadow on the sticky LivePriceSummaryCard sidebar over scrolling booking forms.

shadows.name: modal-scrim-lift
shadows.purpose: Deep modal lift on BookingConfirmationModal above the 60% espresso backdrop scrim (stripped on print).

motion.name: tab-crossfade

motion.name: surface-enter

motion.name: disclosure-expand
motion.purpose: Height and opacity disclosure for the collapsed RAG Inspector and Boarding duration tray.

motion.name: color-transition

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Terracotta collar-accent CTA for booking confirmation, quick-jump booking, and lookup search.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent-collar, #B84A2D); color: var(--surface-pure, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-collar-hover, #9E3D23); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Glazed-slate action button for structural utilities and page recovery.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); color: var(--surface-card, #FAF9F6); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--shell-surface, #162C3A); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #B8AFA0); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-card, #FAF9F6); color: var(--ink-primary, #231F1D); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-subtle, #EFECE4); border-color: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Top 64px glazed-slate bar housing the collar-tag emblem, segmented workflow tabs, and opening hours.

PETCAREPhòng Khám & Spa Thú Cưng

components.css: .ds-nav-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 20px; background: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); border-bottom: 1px solid #142835; color: var(--shell-ink, #F4F2ED); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-brand-title { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--surface-card, #FAF9F6); line-height: 1.15; } .ds-brand-sub { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--shell-muted, #B7C8D2); } .ds-tab-rail { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: var(--shell-surface, #162C3A); border: 1px solid var(--shell-border, #2C4D61); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-tab { min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #D5E0E6; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #FFFFFF; background: #234357; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--surface-card, #FAF9F6); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--accent-collar, #B84A2D); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-tab-active:hover { background: var(--accent-collar-hover, #9E3D23); } .ds-hours-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--shell-surface, #162C3A); border: 1px solid var(--shell-border, #2C4D61); font-size: 12px; color: #D5E0E6; } .ds-hours-pill strong { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--surface-card, #FAF9F6); } .ds-hours-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #3BB273; }

components.name: Collar-Tag Control
components.description: Pill-shaped species and weight-tier selectors modeled on engraved pet collar tags.
components.css: .ds-tag-group { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tag { padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #C8C0B2; background: var(--surface-pure, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink-primary, #231F1D); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-tag:hover { border-color: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); background: var(--surface-subtle, #EFECE4); } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tag-species-active { background: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); border-color: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); color: var(--surface-card, #FAF9F6); } .ds-tag-weight { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tag-weight-active { background: var(--accent-collar, #B84A2D); border-color: var(--accent-collar, #B84A2D); color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Ceramic Text Input
components.description: Porcelain form input with clay-rim border, icon prefix, and glazed-slate focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 320px; } .ds-label { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-primary, #231F1D); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-req { color: var(--state-error, #B43228); } .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--ink-muted, #756C63); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px 10px 38px; background: var(--surface-pure, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid #C8C0B2; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-primary, #231F1D); transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-muted, #756C63); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(30, 58, 76, 0.15); }

components.name: Service Selection Tile
components.description: Selectable porcelain service option with check state, Spa corridor square, and weight-tiered price.
components.css: .ds-service-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-align: left; width: 100%; max-width: 340px; padding: 16px; background: var(--surface-pure, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--border-rim, #D8D2C6); border-radius: 11px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-service-tile:hover { border-color: rgba(30, 58, 76, 0.6); background: var(--surface-card, #FAF9F6); } .ds-service-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-service-selected { border-color: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); } .ds-service-top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-service-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-checkbox { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); color: #FFFFFF; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-service-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-primary, #231F1D); } .ds-corridor-spa { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--corridor-spa, #B84A2D); margin-top: 4px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-service-desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-secondary, #564F49); line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 12px 28px; } .ds-service-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding-top: 10px; margin-left: 28px; border-top: 1px solid #EAE5DC; } .ds-price { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); } .ds-tier { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-muted, #756C63); }

components.css: .ds-ledger { width: 100%; max-width: 360px; background: var(--surface-card, #FAF9F6); border: 1px solid #C8C0B2; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -8px rgba(35, 31, 29, 0.12); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 20px; background: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); border-bottom: 1px solid #142835; color: var(--surface-card, #FAF9F6); } .ds-ledger-title { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-ledger-sub { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--shell-muted, #B7C8D2); } .ds-ledger-badge { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--shell-surface, #162C3A); border: 1px solid var(--shell-border, #2C4D61); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-ledger-body { padding: 18px 20px; } .ds-ledger-rows { background: var(--surface-pure, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--border-rim, #D8D2C6); border-radius: 9px; padding: 0 12px; } .ds-ledger-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-primary, #231F1D); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1px solid #EAE5DC; } .ds-ledger-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-ledger-row strong { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--shell-bg, #1E3A4C); } .ds-ledger-total { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-strong, #B8AFA0); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-primary, #231F1D); letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-ledger-total strong { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 22px; color: var(--accent-collar, #B84A2D); }

narrative.overview:
Petcare models a modern Vietnamese veterinary clinic and spa reception desk on everyday pet-home stoneware and engraved collar hardware. Warm stoneware grounds, matte ceramic panels, and crisp 1px clay rims establish clinical order without sterile hospital coldness, while deep glazed-slate headers and terracotta collar-tag accents anchor every decision point across AI consultation (*Tư Vấn AI*), live-priced appointment booking (*Đặt Lịch Hẹn*), and self-service ticket lookup (*Tra Cứu*).

The system favors density with breathing room: pet owners see transparent weight-tiered prices in aligned tabular numerals, clear color-coded service corridors (Spa, Medical, Boarding), and a calm workspace free of neon-teal healthcare tropes, floating cartoon sticker patterns, RGB AI glows, and heavy drop shadows. Motion stays brisk and respectful (`160ms–200ms` transitions, `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"`, and `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` fallbacks), while technical RAG metadata remains tucked behind an optional collapsed inspector toggle.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile four-step warm ceramic surface ladder (`#F4F2ED` ground, `#FAF9F6` card, `#FFFFFF` interactive inset, `#EFECE4` recessed tray) bounded by 1px stone borders (`#D8D2C6`, `#C8C0B2`, `#B8AFA0`).
Deep glazed-slate (`#1E3A4C` / `#162C3A`) reserved for structural navigation bars, ticket headers, step index badges, and selected control states.
Terracotta collar accent (`#B84A2D` / `#9E3D23`) reserved for primary conversion CTAs, active weight tags, range thumbs, and estimated price totals.
Semantic 3-corridor color coding (`#B84A2D` Spa, `#1F6E4A` Veterinary Medical, `#1E3A4C` 24h Boarding) rendered as compact `10px × 10px` square markers and dot badges.
Native Vietnamese diacritic clarity with `Be Vietnam Pro` paired with tabular `JetBrains Mono` for VND currency, weight tiers, time slots, and `BK-` reservation codes.

rules.name: The Restraint on Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Reserve Collar Terracotta (`#B84A2D`) strictly for primary submission CTAs, active weight collar tags, estimated price totals, and Spa corridor markers—never flood entire cards or headers with terracotta.

rules.name: The Corridor Marker Rule
rules.body: Distinguish the three care domains (**Spa** `#B84A2D`, **Khám bệnh** `#1F6E4A`, **Lưu trú 24h** `#1E3A4C`) exclusively via compact `10px × 10px` square markers (`rounded-[2px]`) or `6px` circular tag dots (`rounded-full`) paired with neutral `#FFFFFF` / `#EFECE4` card fills.

rules.name: The Ceramic-Over-Stoneware Rule
rules.body: Establish spatial hierarchy through tonal steps (`#F4F2ED` -> `#FAF9F6` -> `#FFFFFF`) bounded by 1px borders (`#D8D2C6`) before reaching for drop shadows.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every currency amount, weight preset, time slot, date string, and booking code MUST pair `JetBrains Mono` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so dynamic updates never jitter horizontal layout.

rules.name: The Vietnamese Diacritic Clarity Rule
rules.body: Never set uppercase micro-labels smaller than `11px` on primary interactive controls or navigation tabs, preserving crisp tone-mark legibility across `Be Vietnam Pro`.

rules.name: The Single-Viewport Desk Rule
rules.body: Keep the AI consultation workspace pinned cleanly within the desktop viewport (`calc(100vh - 124px)`) so the header, message feed, composer, and live collar-tag rail stay immediately accessible without page-level scroll fatigue.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Rest cards, service options, inputs, and chat bubbles flat against `#FAF9F6` or `#FFFFFF` with 1px `#D8D2C6` / `#C8C0B2` borders; reserve elevation shadows strictly for sticky ledgers and modal overlays.

rules.name: The Engraved Tag Silhouette Rule
rules.body: Render pet profile selectors (species and weight tiers) as full-pill collar tags (`9999px` radius) and functional form inputs/buttons as `10px`-radius machined controls so tactile hardware cues remain distinct from form fields.

dos: **Do** enforce the four-tier stoneware surface hierarchy (`#F4F2ED` ground -> `#FAF9F6` card -> `#FFFFFF` tile/input -> `#EFECE4` recessed header/tray) separated by 1px `#D8D2C6` / `#C8C0B2` borders.
**Do** apply `JetBrains Mono` with `tabular-nums` on every price, weight preset, time slot, date badge, and `BK-` booking code.
**Do** mark Spa (`#B84A2D`), Khám bệnh (`#1F6E4A`), and Lưu trú 24h (`#1E3A4C`) consistently with compact square or dot corridor markers.
**Do** keep terracotta (`#B84A2D`) focused on primary conversion buttons, active weight tags, and estimated totals so visual hierarchy stays unmistakable.
**Do** preserve `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"`, `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` guards, `focus-visible` outlines (`#1E3A4C` or `#FAF9F6`), and `#printable-ticket` print isolation.
**Do** keep technical RAG inspection collapsed behind an explicit `Chi tiết nguồn RAG` toggle inside assistant replies.
donts: **Don't** introduce generic neon-teal gradients, pastel rainbow badges, or glowing AI borders that break the calm mineral stoneware palette.
**Don't** stack drop shadows on standard cards, service tiles, inputs, or chat bubbles; stay flat-by-default with 1px ceramic rims.
**Don't** use Terracotta (`#B84A2D`) as a full-width header background or container fill (keep dark structural bars in Glazed Slate `#1E3A4C`).
**Don't** render Vietnamese UI text in micro sizes below `11px` or drop `tabular-nums` from dynamic numeric ledgers.
**Don't** replace the bespoke collar-tag emblem or `StatusPuppy` SVG with generic icon-font glyphs or ungrounded stock photography.
